comments.body: i tried trading so i get 100+ contrib points see if that helps gift rate but it was the same as getting 35 points trading 50s. tbh i havent tried china yet. im acquiring the MA items needed for that EA armour secret notes book. i just need 1 book from china, taiwan and korea. i was hoping to get the charm of devine retribtutions but ive had 1 of those gifted to me in around 30 gifts ive received :( but i did get a few nice weapons and equipment which ill sell when i get back to EU. ive been at this for about a week now, used around 600 POs just to get the towns rapidly and start to try farm gifts. your trading skills, such as firearms trading for example, will help you recieve more bronze hand cannons(firearms) when you make a trade. check backstocks, recieve goods that are high and you hopefully have the trading skill to match. for those without high trading skills like myself its far easier to acquire EA goods from dungeons. shame there isnt a title like 'nanban trade merchant' which you could get once you have 200k overall contrib points gained that gives +20% to recieved goods, or increase gift awareded rate +10%

I generally have seen this go for anywhere between 150-250m, and (very rarely) Nanban reward armors like this have been known to be quick-sold for 100m in bazaars/company shops.
